concept: 拦截 vs 引离的本质区别
question_cn: 拦截（Interference）和引离（Deflection）有何本质区别？
question_en: What is the fundamental difference between interference and deflection?

options.text_cn: 拦截只能在横线上实施，引离只能在纵线上实施
options.text_en: Interference can be played only on ranks, while deflection can be played only on files

options.text_cn: 拦截需要牺牲子力，引离不需要牺牲
options.text_en: Interference requires a sacrifice, while deflection does not

options.text_cn: 拦截是将己方棋子插入对方联系线间；引离是迫使对方的守护子离开防守位置
options.text_en: Interference inserts one of your pieces into a line between enemy pieces; deflection forces an enemy defender away from its post

options.text_cn: 两者本质相同，区别仅在于谁先动
options.text_en: They are essentially the same tactic; only the move order differs

explanation_cn: 关键区别在于主动方向：拦截是「己方棋子插进去」切断联系；引离是「迫使对方棋子出来」离开防守。本题Rc4+→Rc1是拦截：己方车插入c4、c1两个关键格，卡住白王回路；而引离是用棋子攻击或诱敌，让对方的守护者不得不离开。
explanation_en: The distinction is who moves and what happens: interference inserts one of your pieces to break a connection, while deflection forces an opposing piece to leave its defensive post. In this example, Rc4+ followed by Rc1 is interference because the rook occupies key squares to block the white king's route.
